title: Hollowed Biome
description: Replaces the Deep Dark with a Hollowed-inspired biome, giving it a darker and more unsettling atmosphere.
body:
This resource pack reworks the Deep Dark into a Hollowed-inspired biome. Blocks and details are darkened and adjusted to create a more empty, ancient, and unsettling atmosphere while keeping the look close to vanilla Minecraft. It doesn’t change gameplay, only the visuals, making the Deep Dark feel more mysterious without altering how it plays.
